readingUncertainties: 11SEP is internally contradictory in the source: it is labelled DO yet the 10SEP-dated duty operates through it. I have kept both as printed because that is the only reading under which Days Off = 13 reconciles.
That STBY/TRN times are ends rather than starts is inferred from column alignment plus the 09SEP rest check; the operator never states it in words.
